underlines.text: angry by the contents of her nephew’s letter

reference.text: Mr. Darcy’s letter to Lady Catherine was in a different style, and still different from either was what Mr. Bennet sent to Mr. Collins, in return for his last.

underlines.text: the parading and obsequious civility of her husband

reference.text: The fact is, that you were sick of civility, of deference, of officious attention.

underlines.text: the comfort and elegance of their family party at Pemberley

reference.text: You are all to come to Pemberley at Christmas.
